description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the MyAttendanceRecordAPI class, which is part of the Attendance API in the OrangeHRM project. It tests various API endpoints such as getAll, getOne, create, delete, and update, along with some setup hooks for workflow state configurations.

classes.name: MyAttendanceRecordAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that tests the MyAttendanceRecordAPI endpoints for the OrangeHRM attendance module.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Test retrieving all attendance records via the API.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Test retrieving a single attendance record, expected to throw a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Test obtaining validation rules for the getOne method, expected to throw a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Test creating a new attendance record via the API.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Test deleting an attendance record via the API.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Test updating an existing attendance record via the API.

methods.name: enableUserCanModifyAttendancePreHook
methods.description: Set up workflow state machines related to user permissions for modifying attendance records.

methods.name: enableUserCanChangeCurrentTimePreHook
methods.description: Set up workflow state machines for user permissions to change current time entries.
